MFR_01_frozen_claim: G1A common-restoration and G1B symmetric-generalized subclasses have exact unity stability boundaries; naive alpha(R^-1 K) must be refused for a general heterogeneous directed transcriptomic system.
MFR_03_target_object_native_observable: K=dP/dx, restoration R, and direct local Jacobian J=K-R.
MFR_04_representation_and_validity_regim: Local linearization. G1A requires R=beta I, beta>0. G1B requires symmetric K and SPD R. General directed heterogeneous systems are refusal tests.
MFR_05_strongest_native_comparator: Direct alpha(J): local linear asymptotic stability requires alpha(J)<0.
MFR_06_null_or_competing_explanation: Unity is an artifact of an unjustified homogeneous-restoration or normalization assumption; G2/G4/no-coherent-scalar remain alternatives.
MFR_07_expected_response: Exact G1A/G1B cases recover stable/boundary/unstable truth; heterogeneous counterexamples reject naive unity; degeneracy and nonnormal warnings remain visible.
MFR_08_decision_rule: All frozen exact cases and known-failure cases must pass their predeclared deterministic checks. Any failure stops promotion.
MFR_10_evidence_independence_leakage_map: No TCGA Chi_bio, Atlas placement, clinical outcome, or favored cancer ordering was used to choose matrices, seed, tolerances, or rules.
MFR_11_multiplicity_search_space: Conjunctive exact-case gate; no p-value search. Frozen G1A, G1B, directed-failure, degeneracy, nonnormal and noise-pilot families.
MFR_13_explicit_falsifier: Any exact G1A/G1B algebraic case fails; any frozen heterogeneous counterexample is accepted as an exact unity route; or required degeneracy/nonnormal warning is suppressed.
MFR_14_precommitted_failure_consequence: Repair mechanical defects only. Scientific failure narrows/retires the affected G1 route. Do not retune to rescue unity; if no defensible G1 route remains, elevate G2 for separate review.
